自己运行完整示例

打开浏览器开发者工具的 Console（控制台），粘贴完整代码，无需替换内容。

const original = { theme: { mode: "light" } };
const draft = structuredClone(original);
draft.theme.mode = "dark";
console.log(original.theme.mode, draft.theme.mode);
// light dark

输出 light dark，说明修改嵌套字段只影响草稿，原配置保持浅色。本例只包含普通对象和字符串。
steps.caption: 编辑只把副本改成深色，原配置仍是浅色；取消时丢弃副本即可。图中保留了被丢弃前的草稿值，方便比较。

modules.title: 哪些操作会影响原来的内容

items.title: 修改内容与换个指向
items.text: 修改 draft.theme.mode 会改变它指向的对象；把 draft 重新赋成另一个对象，只是让这个名字换个目标，不会因此改写原对象。数字等基本值的赋值也不同于共用可修改对象。

items.title: 浅拷贝只隔离第一层
items.text: 用 { ...original } 得到新的外层对象，但里面的 theme 仍指向原来的主题对象。因此修改 draft.theme.mode 仍会影响原配置；它与直接赋值的区别是外层已经独立。

items.title: Git 里的指针是什么意思
items.text: Git 分支记录当前指向的提交；通常 HEAD 指向当前分支，分支再指向提交。这是记录目标的类比，不是内存地址。切换分支还会更新工作区文件，未提交改动可能阻止切换；无需另复制整个项目，不等于文件不会变化。

modules.title: 独立副本也有适用条件
modules.text: 深拷贝不是唯一方案，也可以只复制要修改的部分或单独保存草稿字段。structuredClone 只能处理支持的类型，例如含函数的对象会报错；应先让 AI 检查数据。事后复制已经被修改的对象，不能恢复编辑前的内容。

lessonPractice.title: 配置中有嵌套的 theme 对象。用 { ...original } 创建草稿后，把 draft.theme.mode 改成 dark。原配置的 theme.mode 会怎样？

options.label: 也会变成 dark，因为两份外层对象仍共用 theme
options.feedback: 浅拷贝创建了新的外层对象，但没有复制内部 theme。改它的 mode 会影响双方读到的结果。

options.label: 保持 light，因为草稿的外层已经是一个新对象
options.feedback: 外层独立只保护第一层的替换；这里修改的是仍被共用的 theme 对象。

options.label: 等到点击取消时，才从 light 变成 dark
options.feedback: 共享对象在执行属性修改时就已变化。取消不是这次变化的触发点。

en.title: The settings contain a nested theme object. After creating a draft with { ...original }, you set draft.theme.mode to dark. What happens to original.theme.mode?

options.label: It also becomes dark because both outer objects share theme
options.feedback: A shallow copy creates a new outer object, but does not copy the nested theme. Updating its mode affects what both names read.

options.label: It stays light because the draft has a new outer object
options.feedback: A separate outer object isolates top-level replacement. This edit changes the still-shared theme object.

options.label: It changes from light to dark only when Cancel is clicked
options.feedback: The shared object changes when its property is edited. Cancel is not the trigger.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 编辑设置后点取消，原配置也被改了。请检查草稿是否共用了原对象或嵌套对象，按数据类型隔离编辑内容。改完验证：修改嵌套字段并取消后，原配置保持原样；点击保存才更新设置。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Editing settings and cancelling also changes the original configuration. Check whether the draft shares the original or nested objects, then isolate edits in a way appropriate to the data types. Verify that editing nested fields and cancelling preserves the original, and that settings update only on Save.

Run the complete example

Open the Console in your browser developer tools and paste the entire snippet. No substitutions are needed.

const original = { theme: { mode: "light" } };
const draft = structuredClone(original);
draft.theme.mode = "dark";
console.log(original.theme.mode, draft.theme.mode);
// light dark

The output light dark shows that editing the nested field changes the draft without changing the original. This example contains only plain objects and strings.
steps.caption: Only the draft changes to dark; the original stays light. Cancelling can discard the draft. Its final value remains visible here for comparison.

modules.title: Which operations affect the original contents?

items.title: Editing contents versus changing targets
items.text: Updating draft.theme.mode changes the object it reaches. Assigning a different object to draft only changes that name’s target; it does not rewrite the original object. Assigning primitive values such as numbers also differs from sharing mutable objects.

items.title: Shallow copying isolates only the first level
items.text: { ...original } creates a new outer object, but theme still points to the original theme object. Updating draft.theme.mode therefore still affects the original. Unlike direct assignment, the outer objects are now separate.

items.title: What pointers mean in Git
items.text: A Git branch records its target commit. Usually HEAD points to the current branch, which points to a commit. This is a target-recording analogy, not a memory address. Switching branches also updates working-tree files and may be blocked by uncommitted edits. Not duplicating the whole project does not mean files remain unchanged.

modules.title: Independent copies have conditions
modules.text: Deep copying is not the only solution: copying the edited parts or storing draft fields separately can also work. structuredClone supports specific types; an object containing a function throws an error. Ask AI to inspect the data first. Copying an already-mutated object cannot recover its original contents.

distinctions.label: Object reference
distinctions.text: JavaScript object references let multiple names access one object and can be illustrated with pointer arrows. They are not raw pointers for directly reading or writing memory addresses, or equivalent to pointers in every language.

distinctions.label: Mouse and touch pointer
distinctions.text: A visible {c:cursor} and input pointers in Pointer Events locate mouse, touch, or pen input. They are not the data {c:pointer} explained here; CSS pointer-events does not operate on memory.
